cases.scope: Executable bounded composition of one scan-queue operation, acknowledged GC exit and the source-shaped downward resize tree (populations 2..5, every legal retained prefix and every scanner/queue-owner pair in that population, including self/local and remote accesses). Separates queue lock lifetime, synchronization mutex/condition lifetime and processor storage. Queue-empty control permits early GC arrival while a popped operation still must unlock. All-at-exit control destroys sync resources after fast receipt but before sender completion. Join-only control reclaims storage while a retained parent can still signal a joined retired child. Positive requires completed GC queue work before resize, child queue cleanup, retired joins and retained next-round admission before sync/storage reclamation. Whole GC discovery/closure and checked initialization are delegated premises, not imported model transitions. Assumes correct operation-round alignment, coherent release/acquire, successful joins, no new GC queue accesses after the GC-exit admission and weak-fair completion. Excludes simultaneous multiple scanner operations, complete GC, nested GC on resize allocation, failed joins, C memory refinement, signals, VM list retirement, arbitrary population and native acceptance. Controls are proposed unsafe repairs, not an attribution of observed source defects.
